title: Chennai Coastal Deluge (Cyclone Michaung Storm Surge)
summary: Severe cyclonic storm Michaung brought 450mm+ rainfall over 48 hours to Chennai coastal basin, inundating low-lying sectors along Adyar and Cooum rivers.

weather.weatherDescription: Heavy continuous rainfall with cyclonic squall

alerts.source: IMD Regional Special Tropical Cyclone Advisory Bulletin

alerts.headline: RED WARNING: Severe Cyclonic Storm Michaung with extremely heavy downpours
alerts.description: Squally winds 90-100 kmph gusting to 110 kmph and widespread extremely heavy rainfall exceeding 200mm over North Coastal Tamil Nadu. Severe inundation of low-lying urban areas.
recommendedActions: Citizens strictly advised to stay indoors on upper floors
Disconnect electrical mains if water enters premises
Keep mobile phones charged and emergency dry rations ready
Contact Greater Chennai Corporation Control Room 1913 or State Emergency 1070

alerts.headline: FLASH FLOOD WARNING: Overflow warning along Adyar and Cooum River basins
alerts.description: Discharge from Chembarambakkam and Poondi reservoirs into Adyar and Kosasthalaiyar rivers. Riverine roads and low-level bridges are submerged.
recommendedActions: Avoid Kotturpuram, Jafferkhanpet, and Saidapet riverfront corridors
Do not drive through standing flood water
